title: Radon–Nikodym density on a positive carrier: μ ≪ ν⌞M₀ with ν(M₀) < ∞ gives μ = (ν⌞M)·θ with θ > 0 on M ⊆ M₀
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ, ν be measures on ℝ^P with μ(ℝ^P) < ∞. Let M₀ ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set with ν(M₀) < ∞ and μ(ℝ^P ∖ M₀) = 0, and suppose μ(E) = 0 for every E ⊆ ℝ^P with ν(E) = 0. Then there are a Borel set M ⊆ M₀ and a Borel function θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ(x) > 0 for every x ∈ M such that μ = (ν⌞M).withDensity(x ↦ ofReal θ(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (M₀ : Set (Euclid P)), μ univ < ∞ → MeasurableSet M₀ → ν M₀ < ∞ → μ M₀ᶜ = 0 → (∀ E : Set (Euclid P), ν E = 0 → μ E = 0) → ∃ (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet M ∧ M ⊆ M₀ ∧ Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ μ = (ν.restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))
